column3: With respect to the Soudry NYC Multifamily Portfolio Mortgage Loan (7.7%), all 16 residential units at the 2848 Brighton 7th Street Mortgaged Property (0.4%) are rent stabilized in connection with a 421-a tax abatement that is still in effect. Such units are rented at approximately 7.0% below market. The lender underwrote based on full, unabated taxes and in-place rents.
